sources.title: Gangnam Resource Circulation Portal: household waste (schedule, bags)
Gangnam Resource Circulation Portal: recycling by item

schedule.time: 8 PM to 5 AM the next morning
schedule.place: In front of your own house or business.
schedule.appliesTo: Houses, villas (빌라) and small shops. Apartment complexes and buildings over 1,000 m² set their own days and places.

generalBag.name: General waste bag
generalBag.how: The district's paid trash bag, sold at local shops.

foodBag.name: Food waste bag → food waste bin
foodBag.how: Put the bag into the food waste collection bin (음식물쓰레기 수집용기).

ppBag.name: Non-burnable waste bag (PP bag)
ppBag.how: A separate bag for things that must not be burned. More than ten 20 L bags counts as bulky waste.

clearBag.name: Clear or see-through bag, or white net

greenNet.name: Green recycling net
greenNet.how: Mixed recyclables, on recycling days (not Thursday or Saturday).

paper.name: Paper recycling
paper.how: Tie it up or put it in a box. Keep it dry.

cartons.name: Paper cartons & cups
cartons.how: Paper recycling, after rinsing and flattening.

styrofoam.name: Styrofoam recycling
styrofoam.how: Tie it together or put it in a clear plastic bag.

smallAppliance.name: Free small-appliance pickup
smallAppliance.how: Tell the district's collection company first. They give you a date to put it out.

batteryBox.name: Battery collection box
batteryBox.how: At community service centers (주민센터) and on residential streets; apartments have their own box. Collected on Thursdays.

lampBox.name: Fluorescent lamp collection box
lampBox.how: Same places as the battery boxes.

oilBox.name: Used cooking oil collection box
oilBox.how: Locations are on the Gangnam recycling portal map.

bulky.name: Bulky waste (book a pickup)
bulky.how: Book at least 3 days ahead by phone with the collection company or online at the district office. There is a fee per item. Put the receipt or booking number on the item. Picked up Monday to Saturday (not Sundays or public holidays).

depositReturn.name: Return to a store for the deposit
depositReturn.how: Bottles with the deposit logo go back to supermarkets or convenience stores that sell them.

items.name: Clear plastic bottle (water, drinks)
prep: Crush it and close the cap

items.name: Other plastics (colored bottles, containers, cups)
items.note: Clear disposable cups and clear fruit containers go here too. They are not clear PET bottles.

items.name: Plastic bags & wrappers (snack, ramyeon, bubble wrap)
prep: Collect only plastic film in the bag
items.note: If you can't rinse it clean, put it in the PP bag instead. Tablecloths, foil-lined film and duvet covers can't be recycled as film.

items.name: Styrofoam (white)
prep: Remove tape, stickers and shipping labels
Tie it together or put it in a clear bag
items.pickupNote: The district doesn't say which day for Styrofoam. Check your building's notice board.
items.note: Colored or dirty Styrofoam, fruit packaging foam and kitchen sponges go in the PP bag.

items.name: Paper, cardboard boxes, books, newspaper
prep: Tie it up or put it in a box
items.pickupNote: The district's schedule doesn't list paper by name. Check your building's notice board.

items.name: Pizza box
prep: Tear off greasy or food-stained parts and put them in the general waste bag
Recycle only the clean parts as paper
items.pickupNote: The district's schedule doesn't list paper by name. Check your building's notice board.
items.note: Gangnam says paper stained with oil or food can't be recycled.

items.name: Milk & juice cartons, paper cups
items.pickupNote: The district's schedule doesn't list cartons by name. Check your building's notice board.
items.note: Paper cup-noodle containers: rinse them first.

items.name: Receipts, foil paper, wallpaper, dirty paper
items.note: Gangnam lists these as paper that can't be recycled. Small amounts of wallpaper go in the PP bag.

items.name: Drink & food cans
prep: Sort the lid by its material

items.name: Spray cans & butane gas
prep: Fire risk: make a hole to empty it completely
Keep these apart from other cans

items.name: Scrap metal (tools, wire, nails, pots)
prep: Put it in a bag or tie it together

items.name: Glass bottles
prep: Remove the cap and sort it by material
items.note: Bottles with the deposit logo can be returned to stores for money: up to 30 per person per visit, undamaged and clean.

items.name: Broken glass, mirrors, ceramics, heat-proof dishes
items.note: These can't be recycled with glass bottles.

items.name: Food waste (leftovers, fruit peel, kimchi)
prep: Drain as much water as possible
Rinse salty food (kimchi, doenjang, gochujang) with water
Keep out caps, chopsticks, paper, metal, toothpicks, glass, plastic and rubber bands

items.name: Bones, shells, tea bags, eggshells
items.note: These are not food waste in Gangnam. Herbal medicine dregs (한약 찌꺼기) also go in the general bag.

items.name: Shoes, cushions, umbrellas, hangers, rubber gloves, cat litter
items.note: Clean, reusable shoes can go in a clothing bin instead.

items.name: Batteries & power banks
prep: Take it out of the device
items.pickupNote: Boxes are usually emptied on Thursdays.
items.note: Never put batteries in any trash bag. They can start fires.

items.name: Fluorescent lamps & LED bulbs
items.pickupNote: Boxes are usually emptied on Thursdays.
items.note: Broken fluorescent lamps: wrap in newspaper and put in the general bag. Flat or panel LED lights (not bulb or tube shaped) go in the PP bag or as bulky waste.

items.name: Used cooking oil
items.note: Don't pour it down the drain. Animal fat isn't accepted. Dispose of it yourself.

items.name: Clothes, bags & shoes (reusable)
items.note: Not accepted: duvets, pillows, wheeled suitcases, or dirty clothes, bags and shoes.

items.name: Furniture, mattresses & large items
prep: Book a pickup at least 3 days ahead
Attach the receipt or write the booking number and your phone number on the item
items.pickupNote: Picked up Monday to Saturday (not Sundays or public holidays) after you book.

items.name: Small electronics
prep: Book the free pickup, then put it out in front of your home on the given date
items.note: Apartments use their building's designated spot.
